system.description:
Favoured weapon: Whip

Granted power: Advantage on Persuasion and Performance. Once/day: one creature within 30ft that can see you is Charmed by you for 1 minute (Will save negates; it saves again whenever you or your allies harm it).

Allegiance: Chaotic Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Sune in the World of Arneyan wiki.
